theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_ic_measure_le_of_weighted_orient_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R₁ R₂ R : IMRep U n) (p₁ p₂ : ℤ), (∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], R.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ) • R.orient y) x = (p₁ : ℝ) • R₁.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₁.mult y : ℝ) • R₁.orient y) x + (p₂ : ℝ) • R₂.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₂.mult y : ℝ) • R₂.orient y) x) → R.measure ≤ (p₁.natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) • R₁.measure + (p₂.natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) • R₂.measure
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
